# SEO Birmingham

> SEO Birmingham is a local SEO consultancy serving businesses in Birmingham, Solihull, and the West Midlands. Run by Sunny Patel, an independent SEO consultant specialising in technical SEO, AI search optimisation, and local search marketing.
